title: BridgeClient.loadDeck silently falls back to a test deck
description:
The bridge client currently hides missing or unreadable deck inputs by swapping in a synthetic test deck instead of failing fast.
- `Mage.Client.Bridge/src/main/java/mage/client/bridge/BridgeClient.java` returns `createTestDeck()` when `deckPath` is missing, the file does not exist, parsing produces an empty deck, or deck parsing throws.
- This violates the repo-wide fail-fast rule in `AGENTS.md` and can make keepAlive runs or MCP-driven games play the wrong deck without surfacing the real configuration error.
- The bridge should crash with a clear error when deck input is invalid instead of quietly changing behavior.
